The '''Quadex power core''' was the main [[Power core/Legends|power core]] of the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation's]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. It made use of a [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]] [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|annihilator]], and so was much more powerful than the portable chemical, [[Nuclear fission|fission]] and [[Nuclear fusion|fusion]] reactors used in domestic devices.

Energy from the power core was routed to the YT-1300's propulsion units by a progressive combustion reaction [[Power converter/Legends|power converter]], located in the freighter's number three hold. The power core was housed within the YT-1300's central hub, the most protected area of the ship.

The Quadex power core of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] fed power directly to the ''Falcon''{{'s}} [[AG-2G quad laser cannon/Legends|AG-2G quad laser cannons]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> However, its general appearance was otherwise similar to when it was brand new. It had also been retooled long before [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], the ''Falcon''{{'s}} owner before [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], had acquired the ship.
